This is just what I wanted. When I typed "wor" it suggested the existing "Work" label so I could pick it instead of making a near-duplicate, and the same with "rec" for "Recipes." After saving, the bookmark now carries both labels shown as little chips, and the sidebar counts moved to reflect it. So I can put more than one label on a thing, and it'll turn up under either — that covers my "this is both work and recipes" case nicely.

Putting the labels right in the same edit view as the title and description makes sense to me, and having each chosen label be a removable chip feels right — I can see at a glance what's on the item and pull one off if I mislabeled it.

I'm happy with adding and filtering by labels. What's next?
